statement:
∀ (c : ℂ) (ρ : ℝ),
  0 < ρ →
    ∀ (b : ℤ → ℂ),
      (Summable fun n => ‖b n‖ * ρ ^ n) →
        ∀ (m : ℤ), (2 * ↑π * I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, ρ), (z - c) ^ (-m - 1) * ∑' (n : ℤ), b n * (z - c) ^ n = b m
